body: bd-01M1508AMPV3KR6JAYFZ3SS2MF design checkpoint: PseudonymizedText is now a final proof value with a private constructor and no copy/apply escape hatch. Its checked factory requires an offset map that completely explains the source→sanitized transformation: source/destination spans bounded, ordered, nonoverlapping and UTF-16 code-point-safe; unchanged gaps must remain identical; mapped source text must actually change. Empty/fictitious maps therefore cannot launder raw clinical text. RemotePolicy.evaluate now derives the sanitized value from EmbedRequest itself, so capability and authorized request cannot be bound to a second mismatched payload argument. Focused JVM privacy tests are 17/17 with the concurrently reserved ContractSuite temporarily excluded; waiting for the P1-2 handoff before adapting its one old fixture and running the full cross-platform gate.
